entities.summary: Niels Busk is a Danish politician and former Member of the European Parliament from 1999 to 2009 with the Venstre party, part of the Alliance of Liberals and Democrats for Europe. He sat on the European Parliament's Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development and its Committee on Fisheries.
